info.title: PayResolve AI API
info.description: REST API for PayResolve AI — a PayPal Sandbox payment exception investigator that reconciles shop orders, PayPal captures, refunds, shipments, and webhooks into an evidence graph with read-only AI investigation and human-approved actions.

servers.description: Production deployment on Render (static UI + API reverse proxy)
